text: PR #6659 review found blank DateTime sentinel leakage and an Excel-1900 pre-March-1900 serial discontinuity, and DCO found missing sign-off trailers. The implementation now emits blank DIF/SYLK temporal cells for julian:0 millis:0 and applies the leap-day offset only from 1900-03-01 onward; focused test_prg_engine_data_io passes with blank and 1900-01-01 regressions. I am repairing sign-off trailers before pushing.
